content:
Russia Department of Physics, National Research Tomsk State University, paper Science Behind Scalar Waves. Russian Federal State patent Antenna for transmitting and receiving irrotational scalar-longitudinal electromagnetic waves. #ufotwitter #ufoX

Patent was published on December 15, 2022 (filing date: March 1, 2022).
The patent is granted to the Federal State Enterprise "Scientific and Production Center 'Delta'" (ФКП "НПЦ 'Дельта'")

Technical Field

The invention belongs to antenna technology, specifically microwave-range antennas designed for transmitting and receiving irrotational scalar-longitudinal electromagnetic waves (also referred to as scalar-longitudinal EMW). These are non-traditional electromagnetic waves that differ from standard transverse-vector waves (like typical TEM or H10 modes).

Potential applications include:

Advanced communication systems
Radar

Medical devices (e.g., electromagnetic hyperthermia)
Radio monitoring

Electromagnetic compatibility solutions

As a relatively recent Russian patent (filed 2022, granted same year), it remains active (standard term is 20 years from filing → expires ~2042, unless lapsed).

This design represents an interesting (and quite exotic) approach in microwave antenna engineering focused on generating specialized "scalar-longitudinal" waves, which are discussed in some alternative electromagnetic theories but remain niche/non-mainstream in conventional physics and engineering.

When you start to find published papers and patents from official government bodies and universities, like I have found from the United States of America, Russia and China, it means that this is genuine science, and not fringe/exotic.
